documents.content: The patient reports six weeks of lower back pain. Physical therapy was attempted for four weeks without improvement. A lumbar spine MRI was requested for further evaluation.
A penicillin allergy is documented. The patient reports a prior rash after penicillin exposure.
The patient denies fever, chills, and night sweats.
Type 2 diabetes mellitus is present. Metformin 500 mg twice daily is listed as a current medication.
Right knee pain began after a fall. Knee radiographs showed no acute fracture.
Administrative scheduling note only. The appointment was moved to Monday.
